# Complete Portfolio & Knowledge Base: Bayu Rifki Alghifari

## Introduction
Bayu Rifki Alghifari is a professional Full Stack Web Developer and software engineer with extensive experience in architecting and delivering production-ready web solutions. His core proficiency spans both backend systems (Laravel, PHP, Golang, Node.js) and frontend development (React, Vue.js, Next.js, Livewire, Tailwind CSS).

## Technical Expertise Matrix

### Backend Engineering
- **Laravel (PHP)**: Advanced Eloquent ORM, Service Layer architecture, Livewire, Queue workers, WebSockets, RESTful API development, JWT / Sanctum authentication, Payment Gateway integrations.
- **Golang**: High-concurrency services, microservices, REST APIs, Goroutines.
- **Node.js**: Express, Hono, asynchronous processing.
- **CodeIgniter**: Legacy migration and stable MVC application maintenance.

### Frontend Engineering
- **React.js & Next.js**: SSR/SSG, state management, component architecture, modern responsive UIs.
- **Vue.js (Vue 2 & Vue 3)**: Composition API, Pinia, Vue Router, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
- **Mobile Hybrid**: Capacitor.js, Android Compose.

### Database & Infrastructure
- **Databases**: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis (caching and queuing).
- **DevOps**: Docker, Nginx web server, Linux (Ubuntu/Debian) server configuration, Git workflows, CI/CD.
